MISSING_ANSWER.title: The document has no answer for this question
MISSING_ANSWER.help: Mark or enter the correct answer, or exclude the question. Answers are never guessed.

CONFLICTING_ANSWER_KEYS.title: The sources give different answers
CONFLICTING_ANSWER_KEYS.help: Check each value in the document, then choose the right one or mark the answer yourself.

UNUSABLE_ANSWER_KEY.title: The answer in the document can't be used
UNUSABLE_ANSWER_KEY.help: The value in the document doesn't match any option. Mark or enter the answer yourself.

UNMATCHED_ANSWER_KEY.help: Check in the answer key which question these lines belong to. If they aren't needed, confirm to leave them out.

AMBIGUOUS_KEY_PAPER.title: The answer key holds several papers
AMBIGUOUS_KEY_PAPER.help: Choose the paper that matches this exam to process it again. Your edits are kept.
AMBIGUOUS_KEY_PAPER.helpProcessingOff: Document processing is switched off on this server, so the import cannot be processed again for one paper. Enter each answer yourself, or confirm to skip.

UNSUPPORTED_INTERACTION.title: This kind of question isn't supported
UNSUPPORTED_INTERACTION.help: Change it to a supported type if that truly fits, or exclude it with a reason. Relabelling alone isn't enough.

INVALID_QUESTION.title: The question isn't valid yet
INVALID_QUESTION.help: Check the question's content, options, answer and points.

INVALID_GROUP.title: The question group isn't valid
INVALID_GROUP.help: Each gap in the passage must belong to exactly one question. Check the group's questions or exclude the ones you don't use.

UNASSIGNED_SOURCE_TEXT.title_one: {{count}} passage wasn't placed in the exam
UNASSIGNED_SOURCE_TEXT.title_other: {{count}} passages weren't placed in the exam
UNASSIGNED_SOURCE_TEXT.help: Look at it in the document. If it's instructions or not needed, confirm to leave it out.

UNSUPPORTED_DOCUMENT_OBJECT.title_one: {{count}} object in the document couldn't be read
UNSUPPORTED_DOCUMENT_OBJECT.title_other: {{count}} objects in the document couldn't be read
UNSUPPORTED_DOCUMENT_OBJECT.help: For example a text box, drawing or embedded object. Check whether the exam needs that content.

MULTIPLE_PAPERS_IN_SOURCE.title: The document seems to contain several papers
MULTIPLE_PAPERS_IN_SOURCE.help: Check the recognised sections and exclude questions from another paper.

UNDERLINE_MARKS_MISSING.title: Pronunciation question has no underline
UNDERLINE_MARKS_MISSING.help: Pronunciation questions need the tested part underlined. Edit the options to add it, or confirm if the original has none.

IRREGULAR_OPTION_COUNT.title: A different number of options from the rest
IRREGULAR_OPTION_COUNT.help: Check for a missing or wrongly split option. If it matches the document, confirm.

SCORING_DEFAULTED.help: The document gives no points for these questions. Set each score if needed.

FORMATTING_SIMPLIFIED.title: Some formatting was simplified
FORMATTING_SIMPLIFIED.help: Fonts, colours and layout aren't kept; the content and marks such as underline are.

EMPTY_SECTION.title: This section has no questions
EMPTY_SECTION.help: An empty section isn't added to the draft.

NO_QUESTIONS.title: No questions are included
NO_QUESTIONS.help: Restore at least one excluded question, or check the source document.

NUMBERING_IRREGULAR.title: Question numbering isn't continuous
NUMBERING_IRREGULAR.help: Check for a missing question or numbering that restarts. If it matches the document, confirm.

OPTION_LABEL_REFERENCE.title: An option refers to another option
OPTION_LABEL_REFERENCE.help: This option refers to another option by its letter, such as “Both A and B”, which breaks if the options are shuffled. Reword the option, or confirm if you won't shuffle this question's options.

COLORED_TEXT_IN_CONTENT.title: Coloured text inside a question
COLORED_TEXT_IN_CONTENT.help: Coloured text may be a teacher's answer marking. Check it so the answer isn't shown to students.

UNKNOWN.title: Something to check ({{code}})
UNKNOWN.help: Look at the related content in the document.

objectReasons.INLINE_OBJECT_REQUIRES_REVIEW: This question has a picture or formula in the original that couldn't be brought in. Compare with the original and add it if needed.
objectReasons.LEGACY_NORMALIZATION_REQUIRES_REVIEW: The .doc file was converted; compare with the original to make sure nothing was lost.
objectReasons.TRACKED_CHANGE_REQUIRES_REVIEW: The document still has tracked changes. Check which version the exam uses.
objectReasons.HIDDEN_TEXT_REQUIRES_REVIEW: The document has hidden text. Check whether it's an answer or a teacher's note.
objectReasons.FIELD_REQUIRES_REVIEW: The document has automatic fields, such as page numbers. Check what they show.
objectReasons.TEXTBOX_ORDER_REQUIRES_REVIEW: The document has text boxes; the reading order may differ from the original.
objectReasons.ANCILLARY_CONTENT_REQUIRES_REVIEW: Headers, footers or notes contain text. Check whether the exam needs it.
objectReasons.OBJECT_REQUIRES_REVIEW: The document has an embedded object that couldn't be read. Compare with the original.
objectReasons.TABLE_GRID_REQUIRES_REVIEW: A table has merged cells or a complex layout; check the cell order.
objectReasons.COLUMN_ORDER_REQUIRES_REVIEW: The document uses columns; the reading order may differ from the original.
objectReasons.SOURCE_COLOR_REQUIRES_REVIEW: The document has coloured text; colour isn't kept. Check whether it marks answers.
objectReasons.RENDERER_LAYOUT_REQUIRES_REVIEW: The document's page layout isn't kept.
objectReasons.ALTERNATE_CONTENT_REQUIRES_RESOLUTION: The document has alternate content, such as a drawing with two versions. Check which one is used.
objectReasons.PDF_MARKS_UNAVAILABLE: A PDF does not keep underline, bold or text colour. If a question or its answer depends on those marks, mark them again during review.
objectReasons.TEXT_MARKS_UNAVAILABLE: Plain text does not keep underline, bold or text colour. If a question or its answer depends on those marks, mark them again during review.
objectReasons.PDF_REPEATED_LINE_REQUIRES_REVIEW: These lines repeat at the top or bottom of several pages, so they were treated as page headers and left out of the exam. If one belongs to the exam, such as an instruction, add it back during review.
objectReasons.PDF_COLUMNS_REQUIRE_REVIEW: The PDF page seems to have two columns, so questions from both sides were joined on one line. Separate the questions shown, or use the exam's Word file.

objectTitles.PDF_MARKS_UNAVAILABLE: The PDF keeps no text formatting
